preamble: Total regressive assimilation of the alveolar nasal [n] to a preceding velar stop, turning the cluster /gn/ into a geminate [gg]. The classic case is Middle Indo-Aryan, where Sanskrit agni 'fire' and nagna 'naked' became Pali aggi and nagga; the nasal loses its nasality and takes on the place and manner of the preceding stop. The change is confined to clusters and to Indo-Aryan, so it is rare as a cell.

examples.note: Sanskrit /gn/ became Pali geminate /gg/ by total regressive assimilation of the nasal.
